fan_policy: Unchanged. No fan-control executable, service or host fan setting was used by this work.
thermal_policy: Before each job, wait for the hottest /sys/class/thermal sensor to fall below 55 C; maximum wait 600 s. Record temperature during jobs; this is not an active-job 55 C ceiling.
memory_policy: Microcheck preflight >=40 GiB MemAvailable; full-model preflight >=105 GiB. Record MemAvailable every second; kill the owned container if it falls below 8 GiB while active.
note: Per-run command.json and identity.json record historical settings. Current runner limits do not retroactively describe earlier boots.
